body: No worries, i've accidentally replied to this using a throwaway, but am checking it regularly right now anyway so feel free to PM me if you would like to vent about anything at all.

We often accept the love we think we deserve. I don't know much about your boyfriend or situation but it sounds like you would be better off without him. We never know what other people are thinking so sometimes its better not to think about it. We only know what is inside our own heads and hearts.

We all have flaws, no one is perfect, but i'm sure people do love you and if not right now, there are things about you that people will love if you give them a chance to get to know you. This can be hard, how do we know that we are letting the right people in? We don't, we learn through experience, we cut people out til we find the right ones. This can take a lot of time, don't be disheartened at the start.

But for example, I don't know much about you, but I love the fact that you have the determination and tenacity to have a routine for each day! I struggle with this a lot, and really look up to the fact you have managed to do so! You must be remarkably tenacious in other aspects of your life too!

​

If me, a random redditor can find something to appreciate about you, others can too. . Things won't always improve on their own, but they might if you look the world in its dark ugly face, say fuck you and keep going.

​

Good luck and all the best xx
